method: Read-only reconciliation against the mounted Master Library and the committed corpus index. Every one of the 499 files in the corpus was rehashed in this lane, so a pinned digest is answered by search rather than by lookup, and every bound digest was recomputed from bytes rather than read from a record. Nothing was fetched.
scopeLimit: SOURCE_IDENTITY_FINDINGS SIF-4: private/Nationwide Record Clearing/ is absent from this worktree. Eight obligations across Georgia and West Virginia are recorded held there; this lane reports them unreachable rather than missing, which is a different claim.
releaseNote: Empty. Of the 17 families this lane would release, none has every remaining source bound: New Mexico's four families are fully bound here but their release still waits on the rest of their obligations outside this lane.
grantsNothing: A bound source is a bound source. It builds nothing, proves nothing and approves nothing.

The base number, the instrument and the annulment subject all agree, so this is a variant question rather than a missing document — but which variant a route needs decides which bytes a participant files, and a digest bound to the wrong variant is worse than no bind. The registry's rule for STALE_OR_VARIANT_ID is to normalise the identity first, and normalising it needs the publisher's own form list, which this container cannot fetch.
